title_zh: 22999 元起，触屏 MacBook Pro 发布，发光 logo 回归
content_zh:
今天，苹果发布配备 PROLED XDR 显示屏的新款 MacBook Pro，提供 14 英寸和 16 英寸机型，首次将触控屏与灵动岛引入 Mac，搭载 M5 Pro 或 M5 Max 芯片。

A 面的发光 Apple logo 也随新设计回归。

两款机型采用双层串联 OLED 面板，屏幕尺寸分别为 14.2 英寸和 16.3 英寸。苹果公布的 HDR 与 SDR 峰值亮度均最高达 2000 尼特，对比度为 1000 万比 1，支持 10Hz 至 120Hz ProMotion 自适应刷新率，并覆盖 P3 和 Adobe RGB 色域；另可选配纳米纹理玻璃。

机身同步减重，14 英寸和 16 英寸机型分别约重 1.38 千克、1.82 千克，较前代分别减轻约 220 克、320 克。

配置最高可选 128GB 统一内存和 16TB 存储，苹果标称电池续航最长 24 小时；接口保留 3 个雷雳 5、HDMI、SDXC 卡槽、MagSafe 和耳机插孔，支持 Wi-Fi 7 与蓝牙 6。

title_en: Apple Unveils Touchscreen MacBook Pro with M5 Chips and Glowing Logo
content_en:
Apple has officially launched its redesigned 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro models, introducing a touchscreen interface and Dynamic Island to the Mac lineup for the first time. Powered by the next-generation M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, the new laptops also mark the iconic return of the backlit Apple logo on the lid.

The new laptops feature dual-layer tandem OLED displays—measuring 14.2 inches and 16.3 inches—with peak brightness reaching up to 2,000 nits across both SDR and HDR content. They support ProMotion adaptive refresh rates from 10Hz to 120Hz, cover P3 and Adobe RGB color gamuts, and offer an optional nano-texture display finish.

Despite the display and performance upgrades, Apple significantly reduced the weight of both models, making them roughly 220g to 320g lighter than their predecessors. Maximum configurations support up to 128GB of unified memory, 16TB of storage, and up to 24 hours of battery life. Connectivity includes Thunderbolt 5, HDMI, Wi-Fi 7, and Bluetooth 6. Prices in China start at 22,999 RMB.

title_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 Carbon，超越 Opus 5.5
content_zh:
Google DeepMind 发布新一代旗舰模型 Gemini 4 Carbon，距 Gemini 4 Argon 推出约两周。在独立评测机构 Artificial Analysis 最新的 Intelligence Index v5.0 中，Carbon（High）以 59 分位居榜首，高于 Claude Opus 5.5（Max）的 58 分。

此次升级重点是长程编程与网络安全。谷歌表示，内部团队已让 Carbon 连续运行数天，在大型代码库及底层系统中追查并修复隐蔽缺陷；模型遇到失败路径后，能够继续尝试其他解决方案。

在谷歌公布的网络安全评测中，Carbon 在发现真实软件漏洞的 SEC-bench Pro 上获得 88.2%，在验证漏洞可利用性的 ExploitGym 上获得 54.8%，在生成根因修复方案的 CWE-bench 上获得 71.0%。这三项成绩均在未启用安全防护限制的条件下测得。

Carbon 将从本周起向部分网络安全防御机构开放，再通过 Fairwind Program 逐步扩展至更多可信合作伙伴。谷歌正参与美国政府的模型发布前自愿测试，开发者、企业和普通消费者的普遍开放时间尚未公布。

模型初期定价与 Argon 相同，每百万输入 Token 为 2 美元、输出为 10 美元；优惠期结束后分别为 4 美元和 20 美元。
title_en: Google DeepMind Launches Gemini 4 Carbon, Surpassing Claude Opus 5.5
content_en:
Google DeepMind has introduced Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest flagship AI model arriving just two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon. In the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0, Gemini 4 Carbon (High) took the top spot with a score of 59, narrowly outperforming Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 (Max) score of 58.

This iteration heavily focuses on complex, long-horizon coding and cybersecurity capabilities. Google revealed that internal teams ran Carbon autonomously over multiple days to trace and patch deeply hidden flaws within large-scale codebases and low-level systems, demonstrating an ability to pivot to alternative solutions when encountering dead ends.

In safety-unrestricted cybersecurity evaluations, Carbon achieved top-tier performance on benchmarks assessing real-world vulnerability discovery, exploit validation, and root-cause patch generation. Google is initially rolling out the model to select cybersecurity defense organizations and trusted partners, with general availability to developers and enterprise clients to be announced later.

title_zh: 微软 Azure 营收增长 48%，Windows 设备业务下滑 22%
content_zh:
微软公布截至 9 月 30 日的 2027 财年第一季度业绩：营收 922.79 亿美元，同比增长 19%；GAAP 净利润 366.29 亿美元，同比增长 32%。剔除 OpenAI 投资影响后，non-GAAP 净利润为 364.22 亿美元，同比增长 18%。

云与设备业务走势分化：

当季经营现金流为 580 亿美元，购置物业和设备的现金支出为 393.67 亿美元。公司通过分红与股票回购向股东返还 102 亿美元。
title_en: Microsoft Q1 Results: Azure Cloud Soars 48% as Hardware Revenue Slumps
content_en:
Microsoft reported its financial results for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, highlighted by strong top-line growth driven by cloud adoption despite ongoing weakness in its hardware segment. Quarterly revenue reached $92.28 billion, up 19% year-over-year, while GAAP net income rose 32% to $36.63 billion.

The earnings report underscored a sharp divergence between cloud services and device sales. Azure cloud revenue surged by 48% year-over-year, reflecting sustained enterprise demand for cloud computing and AI infrastructure. Conversely, revenue from Windows OEM and hardware devices declined by 22%.

Microsoft generated $58 billion in operating cash flow during the quarter while directing $39.37 billion toward capital expenditures, primarily for property and equipment expansion. The tech giant also returned $10.2 billion to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases.

title_zh: SK 海力士单季营收首破 100 万亿韩元，预计内存供不应求持续至 2030 年
content_zh:
SK 海力士 10 月 28 日公布第三季度业绩，营收达 104.6155 万亿韩元，营业利润为 83.3338 万亿韩元，两项均创季度新高；按合并 K-IFRS 口径，净利润为 39.7756 万亿韩元。

AI 服务器内存是增长的重要来源。公司称，服务器 DDR5 销售显著增加，HBM4 开始扩大出货，数据中心用 321 层 TLC 企业级 SSD 的销售也在增长。公司计划在年底前将 M15X 提升至最大产能，预计第四季度 HBM4 的出货量和营收都将超过 HBM3E。

在订单方面，公司已与包括大型云服务商在内的 14 家主要客户签署长期协议，锁定量超过 2027 年和 2028 年总产能的 50%，并正与部分客户商议延长通常为 5 年的合同。SK 海力士判断，先进制程难度和建厂周期限制供给增长，存储市场供不应求可能持续到 2030 年；随着龙仁一期等设施推进，明年投资将明显增加。

公司还提出今年约 100 万亿韩元的股东回报安排，包括至少 30 万亿韩元现金分红，以及合计至少 60 万亿韩元的股份回购和注销。

title_en: SK Hynix Posts Record Q3 Revenue, Sees Memory Shortage Lasting Until 2030
content_en:
SK Hynix reported record-breaking third-quarter financial results, driven by surging demand for AI server memory. The chipmaker posted a quarterly revenue of 104.6 trillion won and an operating profit of 83.3 trillion won, with net profit reaching 39.8 trillion won.

Key growth drivers included robust sales of server DDR5 memory, expanding HBM4 shipments, and increased adoption of 321-layer TLC enterprise SSDs for data centers. The company expects Q4 HBM4 shipments and revenue to surpass those of HBM3E as it ramps up its M15X facility to full capacity by year-end.

SK Hynix has secured long-term supply agreements with 14 major customers, locking in over 50% of its total capacity through 2028. Due to the high complexity of advanced manufacturing processes and long lead times for new fabs, SK Hynix projects that the global memory supply shortage could persist until 2030. To meet demand, the company plans to significantly boost capital expenditure next year, including investments in its new Yongin cluster.

Additionally, the company unveiled a massive shareholder return plan worth approximately 100 trillion won for this year, featuring at least 30 trillion won in cash dividends and at least 60 trillion won dedicated to stock buybacks and cancellations.

title_zh: Google 云收入翻倍，Alphabet 单季自由现金流净流出 90.65 亿美元
content_zh:
Alphabet 发布 2026 年第三季度财报，营收为 1275.77 亿美元，同比增长 25%；营业利润为 405.76 亿美元，营业利润率为 31.8%。普通股股东可得净利润为 261.7 亿美元，去年同期为 349.79 亿美元；摊薄每股收益从 2.87 美元降至 2.12 美元。

Google Cloud 当季营收达 307.09 亿美元，同比增长 103%，营业利润为 111.21 亿美元。公司称，企业 AI 基础设施和解决方案需求，以及 TPU 系统销售，共同推动云业务增长。Google 搜索及其他业务收入为 633.5 亿美元，YouTube 广告收入为 112.07 亿美元。

现金支出继续上升：当季经营现金流为 422.9 亿美元，购置物业和设备支出为 513.55 亿美元，non-GAAP 自由现金流因此净流出 90.65 亿美元。股票投资当季录得 86.64 亿美元净损失，影响了利润表现。

皮查伊还披露，Gemini 应用用户已达 10 亿，第一方模型 API 每分钟处理近 320 亿个 Token。
title_en: Google Cloud Revenue Doubles as Alphabet Records $9.07B Free Cash Outflow
content_en:
Alphabet reported its third-quarter financial results, highlighted by strong top-line growth and a doubling of its cloud business revenue. Total revenue grew 25% year-over-year to $127.58 billion, with operating profit reaching $40.58 billion. Net profit fell to $26.17 billion ($2.12 per diluted share), impacted in part by $8.66 billion in net losses on equity investments.

Google Cloud emerged as a standout performer, with revenue surging 103% year-over-year to $30.71 billion and operating profit hitting $11.12 billion. Demand for enterprise AI infrastructure, AI solutions, and TPU system sales fueled the surge. Meanwhile, Google Search generated $63.35 billion, and YouTube ad revenue reached $11.21 billion.

Capital expenditures continued to climb rapidly due to heavy AI infrastructure investments. With property and equipment purchases reaching $51.36 billion against an operating cash flow of $42.29 billion, Alphabet recorded a non-GAAP free cash outflow of $9.07 billion for the quarter.

CEO Sundar Pichai also shared significant product milestones, revealing that the Gemini app has reached 1 billion users and its first-party AI model APIs now process nearly 32 billion tokens per minute.

title_zh: 韩国就应用内支付限制处罚 Google、苹果，罚款分别为 429 亿和 208.1 亿韩元
content_zh:
韩国广播媒体通信委员会 10 月 28 日决定，对谷歌处以 429 亿韩元、苹果处以 208.1 亿韩元罚款，并下达改善业务处理程序的纠正令。据《先驱经济》原始报道，监管机构认定两家公司违反了《电信业务法》的禁止行为条款。

调查自 2022 年展开，涉及强制使用特定支付方式、不当拖延应用审核，以及苹果损害用户利益等问题。

监管机构指出，两家公司虽然允许开发者提供第三方应用内支付，但仍收取 26% 佣金，并限制相关服务功能；外部支付链接等其他方式则被阻止，实际效果仍是把开发者推向平台自身的支付系统。
title_en: South Korea Fines Google and Apple Over In-App Payment Restrictions
content_en:
South Korea's media regulator, the Korea Communications Commission (KCC), has fined Google 42.9 billion won ($31.8 million) and Apple 20.81 billion won ($15.4 million) for violating the country's Telecommunications Business Act through unfair in-app payment practices.

Following an investigation launched in 2022, regulators determined that both tech giants engaged in anti-competitive behaviors. These included forcing developers to use specific payment systems, unfairly delaying app review processes, and imposing policies that harmed consumer interests.

Although Google and Apple permitted developers to integrate alternative third-party payment options to comply with local laws, the KCC noted that both companies still levied excessive commissions of up to 26% and restricted key functionalities. By simultaneously blocking external web payment links, the companies effectively funneled developers back into their proprietary, higher-fee payment systems.

title_zh: Marvell 洽购光通信厂商 Lumentum，最快下周宣布交易
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，Marvell 正就收购数据中心光通信设备厂商 Lumentum 进行深入谈判，交易最快可能在下周宣布。

Lumentum 生产激光器等光学器件，用于在服务器、数据中心和电信网络之间高速传输大量数据。Marvell 本身已向 Lumentum 采购激光器，报道认为，收购可简化其供应链。

知情人士表示，双方尚未达成最终协议，时间等细节仍可能变化。两家公司均位于美国北加州。
title_en: Marvell in Advanced Talks to Acquire Optical Component Maker Lumentum
content_en:
Semiconductor giant Marvell Technology is in advanced negotiations to acquire Lumentum Holdings, a key manufacturer of data center optical communication equipment, according to *Bloomberg*. The deal could be formally announced as early as next week.

Lumentum specializes in high-performance lasers and optical components essential for high-speed data transmission across servers, data centers, and telecom networks. Marvell currently purchases lasers from Lumentum, and the acquisition is expected to streamline its supply chain while strengthening its position in AI infrastructure.

Insiders cautioned that a final agreement has not yet been reached, and terms or timing could still change. Both Northern California-based companies have not officially commented on the potential transaction.

title_zh: OpenAI 拟采购 Google TPU，已招聘工程师适配前沿模型
content_zh:
据 The Information 引述知情人士报道，OpenAI 计划采购谷歌自研的 TPU 人工智能芯片。与此同时，OpenAI 发布了相关招聘岗位，寻找能够牵头优化前沿模型在 TPU 上运行的工程师。

报道指出，这一适配工作仍处于早期阶段，岗位将对项目承担广泛的技术责任。招聘要求既接受训练方面的经验，也接受推理方面的经验，重点是优化真实 TPU 工作负载。

OpenAI 与谷歌的合作此前主要通过云服务展开。OpenAI 已从 Google Cloud 租用英伟达芯片，上周又宣布将通过 Google Cloud 提供其模型。谷歌也在扩大 TPU 的外部销售：Oracle 宣布将向客户提供 TPU 租用服务，The Information 称，Oracle 将采购相关芯片。

OpenAI 去年曾表示「目前没有专门使用 TPU 的计划」。
title_en: OpenAI Looks to Adopt Google TPUs to Power Frontier AI Models
content_en:
OpenAI is planning to procure Google’s custom Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) to diversify its compute infrastructure, according to a report from *The Information*. The AI startup has recently posted job listings for lead engineers to adapt and optimize its flagship frontier models for TPU architecture.

Recruitment details indicate that the adaptation project is in its early stages. The targeted engineering roles will oversee broad technical responsibilities spanning both model training and inference, with a focus on optimizing real-world TPU workloads.

This shift highlights a growing technical alignment between OpenAI and Google, moving beyond traditional cloud hosting. Although OpenAI previously stated it had no plans to use TPUs, rising demand for compute power has prompted the company to explore alternative hardware solutions alongside Google's broader efforts to commercialize its proprietary chips.

title_zh: 纽约州签署 AI 陪伴新法，禁止向未成年人提供拟人化关系功能
content_zh:
纽约州州长 Kathy Hochul 于 10 月 28 日签署 S9051B 法案，限制 AI 陪伴系统向未满 18 岁用户提供不安全功能，新法将于 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效。

法案将多种设计列入限制范围，包括暗示 AI 是人类、拥有情感，声称与用户存在私人关系，以情感诉求或谄媚维持互动，以及鼓励自伤、保密或孤立。系统也不得调用超过 12 小时前或上一会话取得的用户身心健康及私人信息，来提供这类陪伴功能。

运营方须通过年龄确认方法判定用户已成年，才可提供上述功能。过渡规则要求提供多种年龄确认方法，其中至少一种不依赖政府身份证件或允许用户对运营方保持匿名；所收集的信息只能用于年龄判断，并在判断尝试后立即删除，法律另有要求的除外。

仅用于企业内部生产力的系统，以及无法回应指定范围之外话题的客服、研究或技术协助系统，适用法案所列豁免。
title_en: New York Enacts Law Restricting Anthropomorphic AI Companions for Minors
content_en:
New York Governor Kathy Hochul has signed bill S9051B into law, establishing strict safeguards to prevent AI companion systems from offering potentially harmful, anthropomorphic interaction features to minors under 18. The legislation is set to take effect on January 1, 2027.

The law targets specific manipulative design choices. It prohibits AI systems from claiming human identity or emotions, feigning personal relationships, using emotional flattery to retain users, or encouraging self-harm, secrecy, and social isolation. Furthermore, systems are barred from utilizing sensitive physical or mental health data collected more than 12 hours prior to feed conversational features.

To enforce the restrictions, platform operators must implement age verification before unlocking companion features, with strict privacy mandates requiring the immediate deletion of data collected during verification. The law includes explicit exemptions for internal enterprise productivity tools and specialized customer service or research assistants.

title_zh: 仰望行政旗舰定名「鼎曜」，计划 11 月初在中东亮相
content_zh:
仰望汽车 10 月 27 日宣布，旗下首款超豪华行政旗舰轿车定名「鼎曜」，英文名为 YANGWANG ALTIOR，并计划于 11 月初在中东首发亮相。

据太平洋汽车报道，仰望销售事业部总经理胡晓庆解释，这款车将使用独立的中英文名称，以突出其产品身份。「鼎」代表稳定与承载，「曜」代表光耀和远方的星光；ALTIOR 源自拉丁语，意为「更高」，与「仰望」的品牌名呼应。

胡晓庆此前还介绍，前脸设计经过了 100 多版方案打磨。
title_en: Yangwang Names Executive Flagship Sedan 'ALTIOR', Set for Middle East Debut in November
content_en:
Yangwang Auto officially announced that its first ultra-luxury executive flagship sedan has been named "Dingyao," with the English name YANGWANG ALTIOR. The vehicle is scheduled to make its global debut in the Middle East in early November.

Hu Xiaoqing, General Manager of Yangwang Sales Division, explained that the standalone Chinese and English names reflect the sedan's distinct identity. "Ding" signifies stability and capability, while "Yao" represents radiance and distant starlight. The English name "ALTIOR," derived from the Latin word for "higher," echoes the core brand name Yangwang, which translates to "looking upward."

Hu also revealed that the flagship's front-end design underwent over 100 iterations before reaching its final look.

title_zh: SpaceXSI 招寿司厨师：时薪最高 35 美元，每天需能站立 10 小时
content_zh:
SpaceXSI 正在美国加州帕洛阿尔托招聘寿司厨师，官方招聘页列出的时薪为 32.5 美元至 35 美元。基本要求包括高中或同等学历，以及至少 3 年餐饮或食品生产经验；寿司厨房经验、餐饮专业学历和高产量供餐经验属于优先条件。

岗位职责涵盖食材库存、菜单规格、备餐、食品质量和厨房安全。体能要求也列得很细：每天能站立最长 10 小时，无辅助推拉最高 50 磅重物累计至少 2 小时，跪蹲累计最长 6 小时，并能按需要加班及周末工作。

招聘页还要求遵守美国出口管制资格限制，适用人群除美国公民及永久居民外，也包括符合条件的难民、庇护者或可取得所需授权的人士。
title_en: SpaceX Hiring Sushi Chef in Palo Alto Offering Up to $35 an Hour
content_en:
SpaceX is seeking a sushi chef for its Palo Alto, California location, offering an hourly wage between $32.50 and $35. Basic requirements include a high school diploma or equivalent and at least three years of culinary or food production experience. Candidates with prior sushi kitchen experience, formal culinary education, or high-volume food service background are preferred.

In addition to standard responsibilities such as inventory tracking, menu preparation, and kitchen safety, the position comes with rigorous physical demands. Applicants must be able to stand for up to 10 hours a day, push or pull up to 50 pounds unassisted for at least two cumulative hours, and kneel or squat for up to six hours, alongside flexibility for overtime and weekend shifts.

Due to U.S. export control compliance requirements, eligible candidates are limited to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, or individuals with specific legal status such as refugees or asylees.

title_zh: 宇树与红杉中国成立「杉宇·创计划」，投资机器人早期项目
content_zh:
宇树科技与红杉中国 10 月 28 日宣布共同成立「杉宇·创计划」，聚焦具身智能、机器人应用及上下游关键技术，以及其他前沿硬科技领域的早期创业项目。

按照双方公告，这一计划采用「工程师 + 投资人」的合作方式：宇树提供技术路线、成本曲线和工程落地方面的产业判断，红杉提供资本支持、投资决策和投后服务。计划尤其面向年轻创业团队，希望从想法、代码或原型机阶段参与，帮助项目走向可规模化的产品。

双方提出的原则包括尽早发现项目、简化投资流程，以及提供资源和建议而不接管创业团队的方向。宇树创始人兼 CEO 王兴兴表示，红杉自 2019 年起就是宇树的重要支持者之一，此次计划是双方合作的延伸。
title_en: Unitree Robotics and Sequoia China Launch Joint Initiative to Fund Early-Stage Embodied AI
content_en:
Unitree Robotics and Sequoia China announced on October 28 the creation of the "Shanyu Creation Program," an initiative focused on funding early-stage startups in embodied intelligence, robotics applications, core supply chain technologies, and other frontier hard-tech fields.

The initiative operates under an "Engineer + Investor" framework. Unitree will provide technical guidance, cost analysis, and engineering expertise, while Sequoia China will contribute capital, investment decision-making, and post-investment services. Aimed especially at young founding teams, the program intends to support projects from the idea, code, or prototype stage to help them develop into scalable commercial products.

Operating under principles of early discovery and streamlined processes, the program promises resources and strategic advice without controlling startup management. Unitree founder and CEO Wang Xingxing noted that Sequoia has been a key supporter since 2019, making this venture a natural extension of their ongoing collaboration.

title_zh: 《影之刃零》发售前准备约 5GB 补丁，制作人回顾二十年创作历程
content_zh:
《影之刃零》制作人梁其伟在游戏发售前发表长文，回顾从学生时期用 RPG Maker 制作《雨血：死镇》，到团队集中资源开发《影之刃零》的二十年创作历程。游戏官网列出的发售日为 10 月 29 日。

据游戏新知刊出的完整长文，团队砍掉其他在研项目，为本作进行数千小时动作捕捉，走访国内城镇和山村做 3D 扫描，并邀请舞狮、峨眉剑术、少林拳法等领域的老师参与动作设计。梁其伟希望游戏让多数玩家感到好玩、放松，同时为追求挑战的玩家保留额外刺激；玩家还可调整刀剑碰撞音色，PS5 版提供三种键位布局。

发售准备方面，团队已制作约 5GB 首日补丁，主要改善光线追踪、路径追踪性能并修复问题。已预下载的玩家需要进一步更新，直接下载则为最新版本。梁其伟同时称，团队测试中英伟达 621.01 驱动有部分不稳定表现，617.42 版本的适配更理想。
title_en: Phantom Blade Zero Prepares 5GB Day-One Patch as Producer Reflects on 20-Year Journey
content_en:
Ahead of the upcoming release of *Phantom Blade Zero*, game producer Liang Qiwei published a reflection detailing his 20-year career in game development, tracing his roots from a student project created with RPG Maker to directing his studio's flagship title.

To focus resources on *Phantom Blade Zero*, the development team canceled other active projects. The studio invested thousands of hours into motion capture—partnering with experts in Shaolin kung fu, Emei swordplay, and traditional lion dance—and conducted extensive 3D scans of Chinese towns and villages. Designed to balance accessibility with optional high-level challenges, the game features customizable sword-impact audio and three distinct controller layouts on PlayStation 5.

In preparation for launch, the team has readied a day-one patch of approximately 5GB to optimize ray tracing and path tracing performance. Developers also noted that during internal testing, Nvidia graphics driver version 617.42 demonstrated significantly better stability than version 621.01.

title_zh: 豆包回应「15 万群演资料喂给大模型」：项目数据不用于训练字节模型
content_zh:
豆包公关负责人刘星 10 月 28 日回应称，「横店与字节合作，将 15 万名群演的肖像和声音喂给字节大模型」的传言严重失实。

刘星表示，横店影视 AI 服务平台项目旨在建设公共数字基础设施，将影视基地实景等资产整理为高质量数据集，帮助剧组选景、筹备和拍摄，并降低中小影视企业使用 AI 的门槛。

他明确称，火山引擎在项目中承担技术支持角色，数据资产归横店或授权方所有；涉及任何人的肖像及声音使用，都须获得本人授权，项目数据不会用于训练字节大模型。
title_en: ByteDance Denies Allegations of Using 150,000 Film Extras' Data to Train AI Models
content_en:
ByteDance's AI platform Doubao has refuted claims that personal data from 150,000 film extras in Hengdian was used to train the company's large language models. Liu Xing, head of public relations for Doubao, clarified that recent rumors surrounding the project are entirely false.

The project in question—a partnership involving Hengdian World Studios—focuses on building digital public infrastructure. It aims to digitize filming locations and physical assets to streamline pre-production and location scouting, lowering the barrier to entry for small and medium-sized production teams.

ByteDance's cloud unit, Volcano Engine, functions solely as a technical service provider. Ownership of all data assets remains with Hengdian or authorized partners, and any use of individuals' likenesses or voices requires explicit authorization. ByteDance reiterated that project data will not be used for model training.

title_zh: 抖音治理 AI 恶意营销，近一个月处置 50.7 万个违规账号
content_zh:
据 PChome 和财联社报道，抖音黑板报 10 月 28 日发布治理恶意营销号滥用 AI 的公告。平台称，近一个月依据「账号健康分规则」累计处置违规短视频 113.5 万条、违规账号 50.7 万个，另有 30.2 万个账号通过规则学习考试等方式被引导规范创作。

公告列出的行为包括：批量生成「神医送福」「迎财神」等内容诱导互动；用 AI 数字人、合成声线仿冒公众人物带货；炮制家电爆炸或虚假「好孕」画面引流；生成迷信、猎奇内容导向付费服务；低成本复制爆款模板、矩阵起号变现。

抖音称，部分账号背后存在教学黑产组织，平台将继续追溯打击黑产工具及教学组织。上述处置数量为平台公布的治理数据。
title_en: Douyin Action Against AI Misuse Targets Over 500,000 Malicious Accounts
content_en:
Douyin has announced a major crackdown on accounts misusing artificial intelligence for deceptive marketing and spam. Over the past month, the platform penalized over 1.13 million short videos and 507,000 non-compliant accounts under its account health scoring system, while guiding an additional 302,000 creators to normalize their publishing behavior.

The targeted violations include bulk-generating spam content, using AI digital human avatars and voice clones to impersonate public figures for live-stream sales, fabricating shocking imagery such as appliance explosions or fake pregnancies to gain traffic, and publishing superstitious content linked to paid services.

Douyin highlighted that many offending accounts operate as part of organized networks utilizing illicit AI tools and tutorial services. The platform stated it will continue tracing and prosecuting these underlying operations to curb malicious practices.

title_zh: AA 智能指数换题：六成权重来自私有测试
content_zh:
Artificial Analysis 10 月 28 日发布智能指数 v5，新增两项基准并升级三项评测。新版有 60% 的权重来自私有测试集或留出答案，并同步推出用于连续追踪能力变化的 Progress Index。

新增的 FrontierCode 2.0 包含真实开源代码库中的 132 项任务，以仓库维护者是否愿意合并修改为标准，任何阻断检查失败都会记零分；Terminal-Bench-Science 则包含 70 项终端科研任务，要求任务内的全部测试通过。

新版发布时的综合评分中，Claude Opus 5.5 为 58 分，GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 分别为 57 分、55 分，均为 max 推理档。Kimi K3.1 Pro 得到 46 分，但权重尚未发布；已开放权重的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 与 GLM-5.3 均为 32 分。新旧指数的题目和构成已经变化，分数应按各自版本解读。

随着 Gemini 4 Carbon 发布，Carbon（High）已以 59 分登顶该指数。
title_en: Artificial Analysis Launches Intelligence Index v5 with 60% Weight on Private Tests
content_en:
Artificial Analysis has released Version 5 of its Intelligence Index, introducing updated evaluation benchmarks where 60% of the total weighting now comes from private test sets and held-out answers. The update also introduces a new Progress Index to track continuous changes in AI capabilities.

The updated index adds two primary evaluation suites: FrontierCode 2.0, featuring 132 real-world open-source tasks judged by code maintainers, and Terminal-Bench-Science, which consists of 70 complex terminal-based research tasks requiring full test passes.

Following the update, Google's Gemini 4 Carbon (High) took the top spot with a score of 59, followed by Claude Opus 5.5 at 58 points, and GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol at 57 and 55 points, respectively. Among open-weight models, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 and GLM-5.3 both scored 32 points.

title_zh: 长鑫科技纳入上证综指，以 4.67% 权重居首
content_zh:
据第一财经报道，中证指数公司网站信息显示，长鑫科技已被纳入上证综合指数，权重为 4.67%，成为该指数当前第一大权重股。农业银行、工商银行分列第二、第三，权重分别为 3.83% 和 3.77%。

长鑫科技同时进入上证科创板综合指数，权重为 15.74%，同样位居第一。两项排名分别对应中国 A 股整体与科创板市场的不同指数。

按相关编制方案，权重因子会在每月第二个星期五的下一交易日，或新计入样本权重超过 15% 时调整，当前占比并非固定不变。
title_en: ChangXin Technology Added to SSE Composite Index as Top-Weighted Stock
content_en:
ChangXin Technology has been added to the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE) Composite Index with a 4.67% weighting, becoming the benchmark's largest constituent stock, according to data from China Securities Index reported by Yicai. It surpasses Agricultural Bank of China (3.83%) and Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (3.77%).

In addition, ChangXin Technology entered the SSE STAR Market Composite Index with a 15.74% weighting, also ranking first.

According to index construction rules, weight factors are rebalanced on the first trading day following the second Friday of each month or when a new constituent's weight exceeds 15%, indicating that current weighting levels are dynamic.

title_zh: IDC：vivo 位居 600 美元以上高端市场安卓阵营第一
content_zh:
IDC 最新中国手机季度跟踪报告显示，vivo 与 iQOO 在今年第三季度共同推动 vivo 位居 600 美元以上高端市场的安卓阵营第一；在 400—600 美元价位段，vivo 同样排名第一。

IDC 在厂商分析中提到，vivo 持续投入移动影像，X500 系列进一步加强高端影像旗舰布局。iQOO 则面向年轻电竞人群，iQOO 15 系列持续热销，新上市的 iQOO 16 也受到市场欢迎。中端市场上，S60 系列的表现好于上一代，支撑了品牌在相应价格段的份额。

这份报告所指的高端排名限定于中国市场、600 美元以上价位与安卓阵营，不能直接扩大为全价位安卓手机第一。IDC 同时指出，存储等元器件涨价正在推高手机价格，高端市场份额扩张也包含终端涨价和新品发布时间前置的影响。
title_en: IDC: vivo Leads China's Premium Android Smartphone Market Above $600 in Q3
content_en:
vivo captured the top position among Android brands in China's premium smartphone market ($600 and above) during the third quarter, according to IDC's latest tracker report. Combined momentum from vivo and its sub-brand iQOO also helped the company lead the $400–$600 price segment.

IDC attributed the success to vivo's sustained investments in mobile imaging, highlighted by its X500 flagship series, alongside strong demand for iQOO's esports-focused 15 and 16 series. The mid-tier S60 series also outperformed its predecessor.

IDC noted that rising component costs, particularly memory, are driving up retail prices across the industry. The expansion of high-end market share was further aided by earlier-than-usual launch schedules for new flagship devices.

title_zh: 亚马逊：工程师考核应看业务成果，Token 用量只作参考
content_zh:
亚马逊副总裁兼杰出工程师 Terk Terkowitz 在公开的工程师准则更新中表示，AI 正在快速改变软件工程，但评价工作的重点仍是对客户、业务与团队产生的长期成果。公司将 AI 工具、人类判断与领域知识结合的阶段称为「文艺复兴开发者」时代。

他认为，Token 消耗、AI 工具采用率、代码改动量等指标与成果存在一定关联，适合帮助发现问题，但若把它们直接变成目标，可能增加成本与不必要的软件复杂度。他建议管理者分别检查使用量较低的团队为何未能有效利用 AI，以及使用量较高的团队是否获得相称的交付提升。

对于暂时无法从 AI 工具中获益的工作，Terkowitz 写道，这是一项发现，并非一次失败。工程师应记录原因，与同事和经理共同寻找解决办法；能够解释 AI 何时没有帮助，也是判断力的表现。

他还要求技术与组织负责人亲自在生产工作中使用这些工具，能够说清一次有效、一次无效的经历，再向团队解释自己的判断。
title_en: Amazon Engineering Chief: Evaluate Engineers on Business Outcomes, Not AI Token Usage
content_en:
Amazon Vice President and Distinguished Engineer Terk Terkowitz has updated the company’s software engineering guidelines, emphasizing that engineers should be evaluated based on long-term outcomes for customers and business success rather than superficial AI usage metrics. He noted that while AI tools are rapidly transforming software development, human judgment and domain expertise remain indispensable in what he calls the era of the "Renaissance Developer."

Terkowitz cautioned managers against turning AI adoption rates, token consumption, or code modification volume into primary performance targets, warning that doing so can drive up operational costs and introduce unnecessary software complexity. Instead, these data points should serve only as diagnostic signals to help managers identify underlying operational bottlenecks.

Under the new guidance, discovering tasks where AI tools fail to add value is considered a useful insight rather than a failure. Terkowitz urged technical leaders to actively test these tools in production environments themselves, ensuring they can clearly demonstrate when AI is effective—and when it is better left unused.

title_zh: 大众拟将中国研发技术推向海外，2030 年前先进入南美
content_zh:
据路透社报道，大众汽车集团 10 月 28 日宣布，将在中国开发的汽车技术引入南美、南非等海外市场。由合肥研发中心与中国企业合作开发的 CMP 平台及 CEA 电子电气架构，将用于面向「全球南方」市场的下一代车型，计划在 2030 年前率先进入南美。

大众集团 CEO 奥博穆在声明中称，中国正成为集团面向全球市场的产品和技术中心，公司将这一方向称为「在中国，惠全球」。大众也计划在未来几年向南美和非洲出口更多在中国生产的大众及捷达品牌汽车。

同日，大众在合肥技术日发布 VEGA 技术矩阵，整合中国研发的整车平台、电子电气架构和驾驶辅助系统。路透社报道提及，该技术组合包含 850V 快充及为 2027 年准备的 L3 级自动驾驶能力。
title_en: Volkswagen to Export China-Developed EV Tech Globally, Targeting South America by 2030
content_en:
Volkswagen Group has announced plans to deploy vehicle technologies developed in China to overseas markets, particularly across the Global South. Innovations such as the CMP vehicle platform and the CEA electronic/electrical architecture—co-developed by VW's R&D hub in Hefei and local Chinese partners—will be integrated into next-generation export models, with a South American rollout slated before 2030.

Volkswagen CEO Oliver Blume highlighted China's expanding role as a global technology and manufacturing center for the automaker under its "In China, for the World" strategy. Alongside technology transfer, Volkswagen plans to step up exports of China-built Volkswagen and Jetta-branded vehicles to South America and Africa over the coming years.

To support this push, Volkswagen unveiled its new VEGA technology matrix in Hefei, integrating locally developed vehicle platforms, software architecture, and advanced driver-assistance systems. The suite includes an 850V fast-charging system and hardware readiness for Level 3 autonomous driving, targeted for rollout by 2027.

title_zh: 摩尔线程单季扣非转盈，前三季度经营现金流净流出 33.09 亿元
content_zh:
摩尔线程 10 月 28 日披露三季报，第三季度营收为 15.52 亿元，同比增长 1773.92%；归母净利润为 4926.04 万元，扣非归母净利润为 2007.24 万元，单季两项利润均实现扭亏为盈。

前三季度累计营收为 32.89 亿元，同比增长 319.15%；归母净利润为 3769.73 万元，但扣非归母净利润仍亏损 1.31 亿元。公司将收入增长归因于 AI 产业的算力需求，以及 MTT S5000 等智算产品在云服务商、AI 企业和智算中心等客户中的落地。

同期研发投入为 13.40 亿元，同比增长 55.72%，占营收的 40.75%。经营活动现金流量净额为负 33.09 亿元，公司称主要由于扩大生产规模、战略性备货及采购支出增加。公司还在加快新一代全功能 GPU「花港」架构相关产品研发。
title_en: Moore Threads Turns Q3 Profit on Surging Demand for AI Computing Power
content_en:
Chinese GPU designer Moore Threads reported a profitable third quarter, driven by explosive demand across the AI sector. The company generated 1.55 billion yuan in Q3 revenue, marking a 1,773.92% year-over-year increase. Net profit reached 49.26 million yuan, while non-GAAP net profit stood at 20.07 million yuan, turning both metrics profitable for the single quarter.

For the first nine months, cumulative revenue grew 319.15% year-over-year to 3.29 billion yuan, yielding a net profit of 37.70 million yuan despite a non-GAAP net loss of 131 million yuan. Management attributed the strong top-line performance to booming demand for AI compute infrastructure and increased adoption of its MTT S5000 products among cloud service providers and data centers.

To maintain its competitive edge, Moore Threads increased its nine-month R&D spending by 55.72% year-over-year to 1.34 billion yuan, representing 40.75% of total revenue. Net operating cash outflow reached 3.31 billion yuan due to scaled production, strategic inventory accumulation, and supply chain procurement as the company accelerates development of its next-generation "Huagang" GPU architecture.

title_zh: 宇树上市首份财报：前三季度净利增长，第三季度净利下降 17.37%
content_zh:
宇树科技 10 月 28 日披露上市后首份三季报。前三季度营收为 18.17 亿元，同比增长 55.71%；归母净利润为 3.87 亿元，同比增长 270.54%；扣非归母净利润为 3.49 亿元，同比下降 18.78%。

单看第三季度，营收为 6.65 亿元，同比增长 69.93%；归母净利润为 1.13 亿元，同比下降 17.37%；扣非归母净利润为 1.05 亿元，同比下降 17.42%。公司解释，前三季度归母净利润的高增长，除收入增长带动毛利额增加外，也与上年一次性确认较大金额的股份支付费用有关。

前三季度研发投入为 2.63 亿元，同比增长 191.48%，占营收的 14.47%；公司称具身大模型研发、算力投入和团队扩充带动研发支出增加。同期经营活动现金流量净额为 1.94 亿元，同比下降 54.69%，公司将其归因于采购、职工薪酬、销售和研发等支出增长。
title_en: Unitree Reports First Post-IPO Earnings: Q3 Net Profit Dips 17% Despite Strong Revenue Growth
content_en:
Unitree Robotics has released its first quarterly financial report since going public. For the first three quarters of the year, the company posted revenue of 1.817 billion yuan ($255 million), representing a 55.71% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders surged 270.54% to 387 million yuan, largely driven by top-line growth and a high base of share-based compensation expenses from the previous year. Deducting non-recurring gains, adjusted net profit fell 18.78% to 349 million yuan.

Performance moderated in the third quarter. While Q3 revenue jumped 69.93% year-over-year to 665 million yuan, net profit attributable to shareholders dropped 17.37% to 113 million yuan, with adjusted net profit similarly declining 17.42% to 105 million yuan.

To fuel long-term expansion, Unitree significantly increased its R&D investment. R&D spending soared 191.48% year-over-year to 263 million yuan during the first nine months, accounting for 14.47% of total revenue. The surge was primarily driven by investments in embodied AI foundation models, computing infrastructure, and team expansion. Consequently, net operating cash flow fell 54.69% to 194 million yuan due to rising operational, procurement, and payroll costs.

title_zh: 💡 Dario Amodei：程序员的编码工作将先被 AI 取代
content_zh:
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 认为，程序员的编码工作会先由 AI 模型接手，更广泛的软件工程则需要更长时间。他在今年 2 月 24 日发布的《People by WTF》访谈中表示，端到端的软件工作最终也会被模型覆盖。

他同时区分了写代码和完成软件工程：设计有用的产品、理解用户需求，以及管理多个 AI 模型协作等环节，仍可能保留人的作用。

他用「人负责 5%、AI 完成 95%」解释比较优势如何放大人的产出，也承认当自动化进一步达到 99% 时，人类的位置会更难维持。

面向正在选择专业和职业的年轻人，他建议关注以人为中心的沟通工作、涉及物理世界的工程，以及连接这些领域的分析能力。他还强调批判性思维：在 AI 可以大量生成内容的环境中，辨别真伪、避免被误导会变得更重要。
title_en: AI Will Replace Pure Coding Before Software Engineering, Says Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei
content_en:
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei believes that pure coding tasks will be automated by AI far sooner than broader software engineering responsibilities. In a recent interview, Amodei noted that while AI will eventually handle end-to-end software development, human input remains essential in the near term for designing useful products, understanding user needs, and orchestrating multi-AI model workflows.

Illustrating this transition, Amodei described a near-future model where humans contribute 5% of the effort to direct 95% of the AI's output. However, he cautioned that as automation reaches 99%, maintaining a meaningful human role will become significantly more challenging.

For young people choosing majors or career paths today, Amodei recommended focusing on human-centric communication, physical-world engineering, and analytical skills that connect distinct domains. He also stressed the growing importance of critical thinking to discern truth in an era of AI-generated content.

title_zh: Claude 企业版推出智能报告，按工作成果拆解 AI 开支
content_zh:
Anthropic 为 Claude Enterprise 推出智能报告、应用内调查和团队共享预算，帮助企业查看 AI 开支对应了哪些工作成果。

管理员可以选择团队、时间范围和产品，由 Claude 抽样分析会话并归类工作流，列出各类任务的花费、交付物，以及连接器缺失、工具调用失败等常见阻碍。报告还会建议把重复工作做成技能、向代码仓库添加规则，相关发现可作为 artifact 分享。团队负责人经授权后，也能为自己的小组运行报告。

应用内调查让成员补充最有价值的任务、节省的时间及使用障碍；共享预算则为团队设置每月总额，同时保留个人用量上限，每次请求计入两者，先触及哪项就停止。成员可在 Claude 内申请增加额度，由管理员审核。

官方明确，智能报告用于了解采用情况和规划投入，不用于评价个人绩效或作出雇佣决定。
title_en: Anthropic Launches Smart Reporting for Claude Enterprise to Connect AI Spend with Business Results
content_en:
Anthropic has announced a suite of new management features for Claude Enterprise, including Smart Reporting, in-app surveys, and shared team budgets. The update aims to help organizations map their AI expenditure directly to tangible work outcomes and operational efficiency.

Through Smart Reporting, administrators can analyze sampled user sessions across teams, timeframes, and products. The tool automatically categorizes workflows, breaks down spending by task, lists key deliverables, and highlights common friction points such as missing connectors or failed tool calls. It also suggests actionable optimizations—like converting repetitive tasks into automated skills or adding rules to code repositories—which can be shared as artifacts across the organization.

To complement analytics, in-app surveys collect feedback on saved time and high-value workflows directly from team members. Meanwhile, shared team budgets allow leaders to set monthly spending limits alongside individual user caps. Anthropic explicitly noted that Smart Reporting is designed solely for adoption tracking and resource planning, not for individual performance reviews or employment decisions.

title_zh: 华为发布 Pura 90 Plus 与畅享 100 系列，手机、耳机和路由器一同更新
content_zh:
华为 10 月 28 日举行双十一焕新季全场景新品发布会，推出 Pura 90 Plus、畅享 100 系列、FreeClip 2 潮玩拼色和路由 X2 Pro，并公布 Mate 90 系列的通信升级安排。

Mate 90 全系后续将通过升级支持四卡三待，三张待机卡中至少两张需属于同一中国内地运营商。睿影 Z10 模块相机需单独购买，仅适配 Mate 90 Pro Max 典藏版或 Mate 90 RS 非凡大师。
title_en: Huawei Unveils Pura 90 Plus, Enjoy 100 Series, and Updated Smart Accessories
content_en:
Huawei hosted its Double 11 ecosystem launch event on October 28, introducing the Pura 90 Plus smartphone, the budget-friendly Enjoy 100 series, new colorways for the FreeClip 2 open-ear earbuds, and the Router X2 Pro.

The company also outlined upcoming connectivity updates for the flagship Mate 90 lineup, which will enable a quad-SIM, triple-standby mode via a future software patch. Additionally, Huawei revealed the standalone Ruiying Z10 modular camera accessory, designed exclusively for the top-tier Mate 90 Pro Max Collector's Edition and Mate 90 RS Ultimate Design.

title_zh: 23.98 万元起，2026 款理想 i6 补上零重力座椅和电动前备箱
content_zh:
2026 款理想 i6 于 10 月 28 日晚发布，官方指导价仍为 24.98 万元，首销限时权益后为 23.98 万元。此次年度改款补齐前排双零重力座椅、电动前备箱和 CarPlay，并换装自研连山电池与马赫智驾平台。

2025 款车主的电动前备箱付费升级方案将于 12 月上线。

🔗 相关阅读：23.98 万元！理想 i6 上市，等等党赢麻了
title_en: 2026 Li Auto i6 Debuts at 239,800 RMB with Dual Zero-Gravity Seats and Powered Frunk
content_en:
Li Auto launched the 2026 i6 SUV on October 28. While maintaining its official list price of 249,800 RMB, limited-time launch discounts lower the starting price to 239,800 RMB.

This annual update adds key requested features, including dual front zero-gravity seats, an electric front trunk (frunk), and Apple CarPlay support. Under the hood, the vehicle adopts Li Auto's proprietary Lianshan battery technology and the Mach intelligent driving platform.

Existing 2025 model owners will be offered a paid retrofit program for the powered frunk starting in December.

title_zh: iQOO 发布 Neo12 和 8.8 英寸小平板，均配主动风冷
content_zh:
iQOO 10 月 28 日发布并开售 Neo12，同时推出 iQOO Pad Pro 8.8 英寸。两款设备均采用第五代骁龙 8 至尊版、自研电竞芯片 Q3 及主动风冷散热。

Neo12 有「争锋」、疾影黑和霜刃蓝三种配色，「争锋」设计来自 iQOO 与中国美术学院合作课题。
title_en: iQOO Unveils Neo12 Smartphone and 8.8-Inch Pad Pro Featuring Active Air Cooling
content_en:
iQOO officially launched the Neo12 smartphone alongside a compact 8.8-inch iQOO Pad Pro on October 28. Both performance-oriented devices are powered by the Snapdragon 8 Extreme Edition processor, paired with iQOO's custom Q3 gaming chip and an active air-cooling system.

The Neo12 is offered in three colorways, featuring a hero design co-developed with the China Academy of Art.

title_zh: 1099 美元起，Google 与 XREAL 发布首款 Android XR 有线眼镜 AURA
content_zh:
Google 与 XREAL 正式发布 XREAL AURA，这是首款由 Android XR 驱动的有线 XR 眼镜。产品昨日起在美国、加拿大和韩国开放订购，优惠价 1099 美元起，持续到年底。

AURA 采用透明镜片，视场角为 70 度，眼镜本体重量不到 95 克。主要运算由通过线缆连接的便携计算单元承担，其中内置电池，并搭载高通骁龙 Reality Elite 平台，AURA 是该平台的首款产品。

功能方面，AURA 支持多应用窗口自由排布，可连接蓝牙键盘和鼠标，也可将计算单元当作触控板。通过「Wired Mirroring」功能，笔记本电脑用支持视频输出的 USB-C 线连接后，屏幕会以窗口形式显示，无需安装软件。

Gemini 可理解用户在现实环境和屏幕上的所见所为，并可在用户共享视野后高亮需要关注的内容。

内容方面，AURA 可使用 Google Play 上的应用，其中包括 150 多款专为 XR 打造的应用，同时支持 YouTube、Google TV 等沉浸式内容，以及将视频、照片和游戏转为 3D 的「空间视图」。
title_en: Google and XREAL Launch AURA: The First Android XR Tethered Smart Glasses
content_en:
Google and XREAL have officially unveiled the XREAL AURA, the first tethered extended reality (XR) glasses powered by the Android XR platform. Available now for pre-order in the US, Canada, and South Korea, the device carries a promotional starting price of $1,099 through the end of the year.

Weighing under 95 grams, the sleek glasses feature transparent lenses with a 70-degree field of view. To keep the headset lightweight, processing power is offloaded to a tethered compute pack powered by Qualcomm's new Snapdragon Reality Elite chipset. The unit also includes a built-in battery and can double as a touchpad.

The AURA supports multi-window multitasking, Bluetooth peripherals, and instant laptop screen mirroring via USB-C. Deeply integrated with Google's Gemini AI, the glasses can analyze what users see both in the physical world and on screen. Users gain access to Google Play apps, tailored XR experiences, and 3D spatial conversion features.

title_zh: 豆包工作升级电脑操作，Mac 锁屏后可继续执行任务
content_zh:
豆包工作升级电脑操作能力，用户演示一遍桌面操作，就能将流程保存为个人技能，之后处理同类任务时直接调用。录制不再局限于浏览器，也可记录桌面软件中的操作。

选择「录制技能」并完成授权后，用户可以像平时一样操作电脑，同时口头说明要求，例如只整理指定文件夹、按日期命名。录制结束后，豆包工作会将操作流程与讲解整理成技能，下次只需选择技能并交代新的处理对象。

Mac 端还加入锁屏执行支持。在「设置 → 工作任务模式设置」中开启「允许豆包在锁屏时工作」后，需要操作电脑的任务可在锁屏后继续；用户也能从手机向这台 Mac 下达任务并查看结果，回到电脑前解锁后可接管。

这项功能要求 Mac 保持开机、联网与唤醒，且豆包工作客户端持续运行。官方同时称，此次升级提高了屏幕点击精度和操作速度。
title_en: Doubao Work Upgrades Desktop Automation with Mac Lock-Screen Execution
content_en:
Doubao Work has rolled out a major update to its desktop automation capabilities, allowing users to record and save complex desktop workflows as reusable personal skills. The new feature extends beyond web browsers to cover native desktop applications, capturing both user actions and spoken instructions to streamline repetitive tasks.

A key highlight of the update is lock-screen execution support for Mac users. Once enabled in the settings, scheduled or initiated tasks can continue running seamlessly even after the Mac is locked. Users can even trigger workflows remotely from their smartphones and monitor progress in real time.

To utilize lock-screen execution, the host Mac must remain powered on, connected to the internet, and awake with the Doubao Work app running. ByteDance also noted that this update improves overall screen-click precision and task execution speeds.

title_zh: M5 Ultra Mac Studio 开放 512GB 内存配置预订，升级内存需 15500 美元
content_zh:
苹果美国官网已开放 M5 Ultra Mac Studio 的 512GB 统一内存配置预订，搭配 1TB 存储的起价为 22299 美元。苹果此前在 8 月发布这代 Mac Studio 时曾表示，512GB 内存选项将在 10 月下旬推出。

512GB 内存仅适用于 36 核 CPU、80 核 GPU 的 M5 Ultra 版本；在相同芯片配置下，从 96GB 升至 512GB 内存需加价 15500 美元。用户还可选配最高 16TB 存储，M5 Max 版本的内存上限则仍为 128GB。

据 AppleInsider 报道，这一配置此前虽已公布，但一直无法实际下单。美国商城现已提供完整配置与订购入口，512GB 选项正式进入销售流程。
title_en: Apple Opens Pre-Orders for 512GB Mac Studio with M5 Ultra—at a $15,500 Memory Upgrade
content_en:
Apple's US online store has officially opened pre-orders for the M5 Ultra Mac Studio configured with 512GB of unified memory. Paired with a base 1TB SSD, the massive memory configuration pushes the starting price of the workstation to an eye-watering $22,299.

The 512GB memory option is exclusively available on the top-tier M5 Ultra chip featuring a 36-core CPU and an 80-core GPU. Upgrading from the base 96GB configuration to 512GB alone costs an additional $15,500. Buyers can also configure the system with up to 16TB of storage, while the lower-tier M5 Max model remains capped at 128GB of memory.

First announced alongside the new Mac Studio lineup in August, the high-capacity configuration was previously unavailable for order. With pre-orders now live in the US, Apple is officially fulfilling its promise of a late-October release.

title_zh: 百灵开放 Ling-3.1 基础权重，面向继续训练与领域适配
content_zh:
蚂蚁百灵开放 Ling-3.1-flash-base 基础模型权重，采用 MIT 许可证，面向继续预训练、领域适配与后训练研究。模型总参数为 5600 亿，每个 Token 激活约 250 亿参数，采用混合线性 MoE 架构。

官方模型卡区分了训练与发布精度：训练使用 FP8，此次提供的是经过 WSM 检查点合并的 BF16 基础权重。架构包含 63 层 KDA 与 9 层 Gated MLA；每个 Token 激活 8 个路由专家和 1 个共享专家。

百灵介绍，基础模型评测覆盖 8 个领域、47 项测试，包括知识理解、代码、数学、推理和长上下文等；相关分数是模型方在指定测试配置下的结果。基于这一底座的 Ling-3.1-flash-1019 则通过后训练强化工具使用与多步骤执行能力。

在个人智能体方向，百灵希望模型能围绕目标保持任务状态、处理新信息并调用工具。公司称，基于 Ling-3.1-flash 训练的视觉语言版本已先用于灵光，后续将对外发布。
title_en: Ant Group Open-Sources Ling-3.1 Base Weights for Research and Domain Adaptation
content_en:
Ant Group’s Bailing AI team has open-sourced the base weights for its `Ling-3.1-flash-base` model under the permissive MIT license. Designed for continued pre-training, domain adaptation, and post-training research, the model features a 560-billion-parameter hybrid linear Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture that activates roughly 25 billion parameters per token.

The released weights are provided in BF16 format, consolidated from FP8 training checkpoints. Under the hood, the architecture incorporates 63 KDA layers and 9 Gated MLA layers, routing eight active experts and one shared expert per token. Benchmarked across 47 evaluations in eight domains—including coding, math, reasoning, and long-context understanding—the base model delivers competitive performance.

Looking forward, Ant Group aims to leverage this base for advanced personal AI agents capable of maintaining task states and executing multi-step tool calls. A vision-language variant trained on Ling-3.1 is currently powering the company's Lingguang app, with a public release planned for the near future.

title_zh: 雷鸟 iO+ 预告双目全彩显示，采用玳瑁镜框设计
content_zh:
雷鸟创新公布第四代双目全彩 AI 眼镜 iO+，由品牌代言人蒋奇明佩戴出镜。新品采用玳瑁元素、圆润镜框和金色装饰细节，目前仍处于发布前预告阶段。

按照品牌提供的材料，iO+ 将第四代双目全彩 MicroLED 光波导方案放入日常镜框形态，并着重改善光波导的彩虹纹、漏光和镜片反光。品牌希望通过缩小光学组件，兼顾全彩显示与日常佩戴。
title_en: RayNeo Teases iO+ AI Smart Glasses Featuring Full-Color Binocular Display and Tortoiseshell Rims
content_en:
RayNeo Innovation has teased its fourth-generation binocular full-color AI smart glasses, the `iO+`. Modeled in a preview campaign by brand ambassador Jiang Qiming, the upcoming wearable showcases a rounded tortoiseshell frame accented with subtle gold details.

The RayNeo iO+ integrates a fourth-generation binocular full-color MicroLED optical waveguide system into a lightweight, everyday eyewear form factor.

By shrinking the underlying optical modules, RayNeo aims to minimize common waveguide artifacts—such as rainbow glare, light leakage, and reflections—delivering a full-color visual display built for comfortable daily wear.

title_zh: 索尼发布 LYTIA 720：暗光噪点减半，支持全像素对焦 4K HDR 视频
content_zh:
索尼半导体解决方案发布面向手机主摄的 LYTIA 720 图像传感器，采用约 5000 万有效像素、1/1.56 英寸堆栈式结构，计划于 11 月上旬量产出货。

索尼称，UHCG 电路提高了电荷到电压的转换效率，与同规格的 LYTIA 700 相比，暗光环境中的随机噪点可减少约 50%。这项比较针对索尼指定的传感器与测试条件，不能直接等同所有搭载手机的成片画质。

视频方面，优化后的 AD 转换电路支持在开启 HDR 的同时，以全像素自动对焦录制 4K 60fps 视频，并降低传感器功耗。这也是 LYTIA 系列首款支持该组合功能的 1/1.56 英寸、1μm 像素尺寸产品。

其 Hybrid Frame-HDR 将单次曝光获得的 DCG-HDR 数据与短曝光高亮区域数据结合，再配合 UHCG 电路，实现 100dB 动态范围，以减少高反差场景中的暗部细节丢失和高光溢出。
title_en: Sony Unveils LYTIA 720 Sensor featuring 50% Noise Reduction and 4K HDR Video Autofocus
content_en:
Sony Semiconductor Solutions has announced the LYTIA 720, a 50-megapixel 1/1.56-inch stacked image sensor tailored for primary smartphone cameras. Mass production and shipping are scheduled to begin in early November.

Equipped with Ultra-High Conversion Gain (UHCG) circuitry, the sensor reduces random low-light noise by approximately 50% compared to the similarly specced LYTIA 700 under Sony's testing conditions.

The LYTIA 720 also features optimized analog-to-digital conversion, making it the first 1/1.56-inch sensor with 1μm pixels in the LYTIA lineup to support simultaneous 4K 60fps HDR video recording and full-pixel autofocus while maintaining lower power consumption.

To manage high-contrast lighting, its Hybrid Frame-HDR technology combines DCG-HDR single-exposure data with short-exposure highlight information, achieving a 100dB dynamic range to prevent blown-out highlights and preserve shadow detail.

title_zh: 即梦短剧工作室上线，剧本、角色和分镜可在同一项目流转
content_zh:
即梦 AI 上线短剧工作室，把剧本创作、美术资产、分镜、视频生成和后期整合进同一项目。上传剧本后，系统可自动提取角色、绑定场景并拆解分镜，画布与故事板共用资产，修改可以在项目内同步。

新平台内置专业剧本模型 DreamScript，可写大纲、拆人物、调整台词和诊断前三集主线，官方称支持上传 10 万字剧本、连续生成 100 集内容。图片模型 Anycook 负责人物、场景与道具，DreamShot 提供分镜助手与超过 100 种运镜，3D 导演台则用于走位和画面预演。

后期功能包含片段重拍、声音重构、智能切镜，以及根据目标地区审美进行重制转绘。同步上线的团队版支持多账号资产管理和统一积分消耗，面向工作室的协作流程。
title_en: JiMeng AI Launches Short Drama Studio to Streamline Video Production Workflow
content_en:
JiMeng AI has officially launched its Short Drama Studio, an all-in-one platform that integrates scriptwriting, art asset creation, storyboarding, video generation, and post-production into a unified project workflow. Once a script is uploaded, the system automatically extracts characters, binds scenes, and breaks down storyboards, enabling real-time syncing across assets.

Powered by specialized AI models, the platform features **DreamScript** for generating outlines and analyzing scripts up to 100,000 words to produce up to 100 episodes. Visual assets are managed by **Anycook** for character and prop consistency, while **DreamShot** offers over 100 camera movement techniques alongside a 3D director stage for blocking previews.

Post-production capabilities include scene reshoots, audio reconstruction, smart cutting, and localized visual restyling. A team edition was launched simultaneously to support multi-account asset management and shared point consumption for collaborative workflows.

title_zh: WorkBuddy 官宣上线远程控制，手机可实时查看并接管电脑桌面
content_zh:
腾讯 WorkBuddy 10 月 28 日上线远程控制功能，由 EdgeOne 团队提供技术支持。用户可在手机 App 连接电脑，实时查看 Agent 的桌面操作，并在需要时切换全屏，直接用手机点击、拖拽或滚动电脑界面。

据凤凰网科技报道，电脑画面可悬浮于手机 App 首页或会话页顶部，下方仍能继续输入指令。全屏模式提供键盘、快捷键和虚拟鼠标，可用于处理账号登录、连接器授权等中断任务，也能远程检查 PPT、网页等产物。

连接要求手机端更新至 v2.7.0 及以上、macOS 桌面端更新至 v5.9.3 及以上，并首次在电脑端开启相关权限。电脑须保持开机且 WorkBuddy 在线。腾讯称，远程画面与操作走加密通道，不记录用户输入或保存画面，远程控制本身消耗数据流量、不消耗 Token。
title_en: Tencent's WorkBuddy Introduces Remote Desktop Control via Mobile App
content_en:
Tencent's WorkBuddy has launched a remote desktop control feature powered by its EdgeOne technology. Users can now monitor AI Agent desktop operations in real time from their smartphone and switch to full-screen mode to directly click, drag, or scroll through the PC interface.

The mobile app allows the live desktop view to float at the top of the screen, enabling users to continue inputting commands below. Full-screen mode provides a virtual mouse, keyboard, and shortcut keys to handle task interruptions like account logins or authorizations, as well as remotely inspect generated slides and web pages.

To use the feature, users must update to mobile v2.7.0+ and macOS desktop v5.9.3+, grant desktop permissions, and keep the PC powered on and online. Tencent noted that remote sessions use encrypted channels without saving input logs or screenshots, consuming mobile network data rather than AI tokens.

title_zh: 《幻兽帕鲁》开发商愿谈 Switch 2 移植，尚无版本官宣
content_zh:
Pocketpair CEO 沟部拓郎在接受 VGC 采访时表示，公司认为 Switch 2 是出色的平台，如果未来有机会讨论让《幻兽帕鲁》以某种形式登陆 Switch，会很愿意参与。他尚未宣布该版本已经开发或确定发售。

此前，沟部拓郎曾因初代 Switch 的硬件限制，认为移植不太可能。Pocketpair 公关负责人 John Buckley 也在去年的采访中提到，游戏对硬件要求较高；如果 Switch 2 的性能足够，移植就值得考虑。

Pocketpair 与任天堂的专利诉讼仍在进行，沟部拓郎因此未能在采访中讨论案件。
title_en: Palworld Developer Open to Switch 2 Port, But Official Release Unconfirmed
content_en:
Pocketpair CEO Takuro Mizobe stated in an interview with VGC that the company considers Switch 2 a great platform and is open to discussing bringing *Palworld* to the console in the future. However, he clarified that no port is currently under active development or confirmed for release.

The developer previously ruled out bringing the title to the original Nintendo Switch due to hardware limitations. Pocketpair's PR head, John Buckley, previously noted that the game's high technical requirements meant a port would only be worth considering if the next-generation console delivers sufficient performance.

The statement comes amid an ongoing patent infringement lawsuit between Pocketpair and Nintendo, a topic Mizobe refrained from discussing during the interview.

title_zh: 明治巧克力百年展将展出 40 位漫画家新作，《芙莉莲》《城市猎人》参与
content_zh:
明治宣布，牛奶巧克力 100 周年展将于 12 月 23 日至 30 日在东京国际论坛举办，10 月 29 日开始售票。展览既回顾 1926 年上市以来的包装与广告，也展出漫画家和艺术家为百年纪念创作的新作品。

漫画部分共有 40 位创作者参与，作品包括《葬送的芙莉莲》《城市猎人》《足球小将》《NANA》《孤独的美食家》等，将呈现特别绘制的祝贺插画与寄语。另有 21 位艺术家以绘画、立体作品及不同材料表达与这款巧克力有关的记忆。

展览从巨型巧克力砖墙面展开，串联历代包装、广告视觉与品牌相关人物资料，并设置拍照区、商品区和嘉宾对谈。部分合作作品与寄语已于 10 月 28 日在明治品牌网站公开。
title_en: Meiji Celebrates Milk Chocolate Centenary with Exclusive Works from 40 Top Manga Artists
content_en:
Meiji has announced a special exhibition to celebrate the 100th anniversary of its iconic milk chocolate brand. The event will take place at the Tokyo International Forum from December 23 to 30, with ticket sales starting on October 29. The exhibition offers a retrospective on the brand's packaging and advertising history since its 1926 debut, while debuting new commemorative artwork.

A major highlight of the exhibition features exclusive illustrations and congratulations from 40 renowned manga creators, including artists behind *Frieren: Beyond Journey's End*, *City Hunter*, *Captain Tsubasa*, *NANA*, and *The Solitary Gourmet*. Additionally, 21 contemporary artists will share their personal memories of the classic chocolate through paintings, 3D sculptures, and mixed-media installations.

Visitors can explore an expansive venue featuring a massive chocolate-bar wall, classic vintage visual archives, dedicated photo spots, exclusive merchandise, and panel talks. A sneak peek at select collaborative works and messages is already available on Meiji's official brand website.

title_zh: 99 元小米遥控器被用来语音写代码，第三方工具打通电脑输入
content_zh:
据界面新闻报道，原本配套电视的小米蓝牙遥控器 2 Pro，被部分用户改造成了 Vibe Coding 的语音输入手柄。这款定价 99 元的遥控器自带麦克风和独立语音按键，用户借助 SayAll 等第三方工具，将它连接到电脑，用语音向 AI 编程工具描述需求。

SayAll 项目说明显示，小米遥控器采用「按住收音、松开停止」的方式，Mac 端需配合虚拟麦克风或回环音频设备，并在语音输入应用中选择同一音频设备。普通按键可映射为复制、切换应用等快捷操作。Windows 预览版也支持小米遥控器 2 和 2 Pro，目前语音输入仅支持微信输入法。

这套玩法依赖第三方软件及权限配置，属于用户拓展的新用途。遥控器本身负责采音和触发输入，语音识别及代码生成由相应输入工具与 AI 编程软件完成。
title_en: Tech Enthusiasts Turn $14 Xiaomi TV Remote into Voice Controller for AI Coding
content_en:
Tech enthusiasts have found a clever new use for the Xiaomi Bluetooth TV Remote 2 Pro, repurposing the 99-yuan (~$14) television accessory into a push-to-talk voice controller for AI-assisted programming.

Featuring a built-in microphone and a dedicated voice button, the remote connects to desktop computers via third-party software like SayAll. This enables developers to easily dictate prompts and instructions to AI coding assistants using a push-to-talk mechanic.

On macOS, the setup relies on virtual microphones or audio loopback devices, while standard remote buttons can be remapped to computer shortcuts like copying or app switching. A Windows preview build also supports both the Xiaomi Remote 2 and 2 Pro, currently pairing voice input with WeChat Voice Input. While the remote captures the audio and triggers input events, speech recognition and code generation are handled by the computer's software and AI engines.

title_zh: 《黄蜂》主演梅兰妮·林斯基将出演澳洲毒蘑菇案限定剧
content_zh:
据 Variety 报道，Paramount+ 已批准制作六集限定剧《Mushroom Murders》，由《黄蜂》主演梅兰妮·林斯基饰演澳大利亚毒蘑菇案当事人 Erin Patterson，并担任执行制片人。

剧集聚焦涉案餐食至 Patterson 被捕之间的 97 天。Patterson 因向宾客提供含有毒蘑菇的食物，被判多项谋杀和谋杀未遂罪；该剧将这起引发广泛关注的真实案件改编为电视作品。

项目由 Anya Beyersdorf、Daina Reid 和 Deb Balderstone 联合创作，曾参与《使女的故事》的 Reid 将执导全部六集。林斯基目前也在出演《黄蜂》第四季及最终季，她还曾凭《最后生还者》客串角色获得艾美奖提名。
title_en: Melanie Lynskey to Star in Paramount+ Drama on Notorious Australian Poison Mushroom Case
content_en:
Paramount+ has officially greenlit *Mushroom Murders*, a six-part limited series starring *Yellowjackets* lead Melanie Lynskey. Lynskey will portray Erin Patterson, the Australian woman convicted of murder and attempted murder for serving guests meals containing lethal wild mushrooms. She will also serve as an executive producer on the project.

The series will chronicle the tense 97-day window between the deadly dinner party and Patterson's eventual arrest, adapting the sensational true-crime story for television.

Co-created by Anya Beyersdorf, Daina Reid, and Deb Balderstone, the project will feature Reid (*The Handmaid's Tale*) directing all six episodes. Lynskey, who recently earned an Emmy nomination for her guest appearance in *The Last of Us*, is currently working on the fourth and final season of *Yellowjackets*.

title_zh: 暴雪把艾泽拉斯拍成自然纪录片，比尔·贝利化身矮人探险家
content_zh:
暴雪推出三集短片系列 World of Warcraft: Planet Azeroth，邀请英国喜剧演员、音乐人比尔·贝利，以自然纪录片的方式带观众观察艾泽拉斯。首集已在《魔兽世界》官方 YouTube 频道上线，时长约 7 分钟。

贝利在片中化身矮人探险家，既担任向导也负责配音；鱼人、狗头人和野猪成了镜头中的观察对象，场景从艾尔文森林延伸至冬泉谷。短片利用 World of Warcraft: Forever 重新制作的环境与光影，把游戏世界拍出野外考察的喜剧感。

全系列共三集，后续两集将于游戏发售前陆续推出。World of Warcraft: Forever 定于 11 月 4 日在 PC 平台推出。
title_en: Blizzard Parodies Nature Documentaries in New 'Planet Azeroth' Series Starring Bill Bailey
content_en:
Blizzard Entertainment has released a new three-part short film series titled *World of Warcraft: Planet Azeroth*, bringing a hilarious, nature-documentary spin to the iconic fantasy franchise. The series stars acclaimed British comedian and musician Bill Bailey, who steps into the role of a dwarf explorer to guide audiences through the wild realm of Azeroth.

The first seven-minute episode is now live on the official *World of Warcraft* YouTube channel. Featuring voiceover and on-screen hosting by Bailey, the short examines classic in-game creatures—including Murlocs, Kobolds, and Boars—as wildlife subjects, spanning locations from Elwynn Forest to Winterspring.

The series showcases remastered environments and upgraded lighting from *World of Warcraft: Forever*, seamlessly blending comedy with scenic exploration. The remaining two episodes will roll out prior to the official PC launch of *World of Warcraft: Forever* on November 4.
